rows.en: Oh, switching to D3 doesn't help after all. What on earth is going on?
I can at least look after myself.

rows.notes: Short shout (haa!), no words.

rows.en: Forget about me. It's too late!
I think these giants may have been the same size as us originally.
Maybe they modified their own bodies to be bigger and stronger to fight an enemy called the Supervision Army.
rows.notes: Whisper wrote the army's name with the wrong first kanji; glossary form is Supervision Army.

rows.en: Besides, people who can survive in a vacuum and fight Battroids bare-handed couldn't have evolved naturally, could they?
The Protoculture the giants talk about may mean the civilization from when they were still our size.
Maybe the giants are interested in us and the Macross because we have that Protoculture.

rows.notes: Whisper no-speech warning; transcript plausible.

rows.en: Deploy the Spartans to the deck.
Major, your nose is dropping. Are you all right?
Valkyrie to Lieutenant Dream, your order has arrived. Return at once.
rows.notes: Transcript is odd ('Valkyrie-tai' vs 'Valkyrie-tsui'); 'Lieutenant Dream' is not in the glossary. Possibly a code phrase.

rows.en: All Valkyrie squadrons, evacuate far away immediately! I repeat, evacuate far away immediately!
rows.notes: Whisper used the wrong kanji for 'tsugu' (announce); sense unchanged.

rows.en: We can't hold out! You all must survive, at least!
The shuttle is crippled. We're evacuating.
Please respond. If there are any survivors, respond.
Valkyrie Eastern Patrol, Max and Midia squads: Quamzin's faction is believed to be after the reaction engines. Defend the reaction engines at the industrial complex block.
rows.notes: Whisper wrote 'dasshu' (dash) where 'dasshu' (seizing, a wrong-kanji homophone) is meant; read as seizing the engines. 'Midia' squad is not in the glossary and is a guess from the transcript.

rows.en: Main gun will fire now. Evacuate the area around the enemy ships immediately!

rows.notes: Yarou-domo is rough; 'boys' chosen to keep it addressed to his own troops.
Whisper wrote 'Quamzin dan'; read as 'Quamzin da' (this is Quamzin).
Shout (eifooku), no clear words.
Whisper wrote 'nani shiyou'; read as a startled 'what the...' (sibling clip is a surprised 'what is this').
Roar, no words.
Growl of anger, no words.
Shout (jea / zakuru), no clear words.
Shout (zaakuru), not understood.
Whisper wrote 'kiss me'; not understood, probably a cry of pain or anger.
Laughter, no words.
Whisper wrote 'urushii'; read as 'urusai' (shut up). 'Annoying' is the other option.
Laughter, no words.
Whisper wrote 'nigasuke'; read as 'nigasu ka'.
Whisper wrote 'sarayo'; guessed 'saraba'. Could be another kill line.
Yarou-domo is rough; kept a gruff form of address.
Whisper no-speech warning; transcript plausible.
Whisper wrote 'zakuru'; shout, not understood.
Whisper wrote a repeated laugh; no words.

rows.en: I can't get enough of this!

rows.notes: Whisper wrote 'rakunakaridane'; read as 'raku na kari da ne'.
Whisper wrote 'kanarazu shield'; read as 'shimatta, shield ga'.

rows.en: I don't need this thing anyway!
What the hell is going on?!

rows.notes: Whisper wrote 'kono teido no teido'; sentence is cut off, reading is a guess.
Whisper wrote 'uttoushuu'; read as 'uttoushii'.
Shout (eifosu), no clear words.
Whisper wrote 'kushat'; read as 'kuso'.

rows.en: Damn it, I can still fight!

rows.notes: Whisper wrote 'yarenri'; read as 'yareru'.
Whisper wrote 'kono sukka ga'; read as an insult like 'kono yarou ga'.
